z-m-40-07.title: Ukuba siphakamisa umgca othe tye, ingaba amanqaku okudibana akhula kuphela?
z-m-40-07.topic: Igrafu ye-quadratic enexabiso eliphelele y=|x²−4| nendlela inani lamanqaku okudibana nomgca othe tye elitshintsha ngayo
z-m-40-07.goal: Chaza ukuba kutheni inani lamanqaku okudibana lingakhuli nje kuphela kodwa litshintsha njengoko ubude k bomgca othe tye butshintsha, uyidibanise nemo yegrafu (incopho egqunyiweyo nephuzu elichukumisa i-x-axis).
z-m-40-07.material: Inani lamanqaku apho igrafu yomsebenzi y = |x² − 4| (funda: 'ixabiso eliphelele lika-x isikwere ukususa 4') idibana nomgca othe tye y = k lilingana nenani lezingcambu ezahlukileyo zokwenyani ze-equation |x² − 4| = k. Ngezantsi ngamaxabiso e-y abalwe kwamanye amaxabiso e-x. Xa x ingu-−3, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y ingu-5, 0, 3, 4, 3, 0, 5.
z-m-40-07.prereq.0: Inqanaba elabelweyo H3 libubunzima kuphela kulo mthamo wemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibeka olu lwazi kwibanga elithile. Ingcamango: sele uyayazi igrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic, intsingiselo yexabiso eliphelele, nenkcazelo yokuba izingcambu zokwenyani ze-equation ngamanqaku okudibana kwegrafu nomgca othe tye.
z-m-40-07.prereq.1: Izisombululo ze-equation ye-quadratic x² = m (ezimbini ukuba m > 0, enye ukuba m = 0, akukho ukuba m < 0)
z-m-40-07.prereq.2: Ixabiso eliphelele |t| yi-t ukuba t ≥ 0 kwaye yi-−t ukuba t < 0
z-m-40-07.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa njengoko k itshintsha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha inani lamanqaku okudibana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.0: Landela amaxabiso kwitheyibhile, ubale inani lamaxesha apho igrafu idlula indawo apho y = k, isithuba esinye ngexesha.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hlula zibe zii-equation ezimbini x² − 4 = k no-x² − 4 = −k, uze usebenze ukuba zingaphi x eziphuma kunye nganye.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Qala, zoba umgca othe tye y = 1, ene-k = 1.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mangaphi amanqaku ahlukileyo abelana ngawo umgca othe tye y = 1 negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.after: |x² − 4| = 1 ithetha x² − 4 = 1 okanye x² − 4 = −1, ngoko x² = 5 okanye x² = 3. x = ±√5, ±√3, amanqaku ama-4. Kwitheyibhile, amaxabiso ehla ukusuka kwi-x = 1 (y = 3) ukuya kwi-x = 2 (y = 0), kwaye anyuka ukusuka kwi-x = 2 ukuya kwi-x = 3 (y = 5), ngoko ekunene idlula y = 1 kabini, kwaye icala lasekhohlo lifana.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba idibana njengobhanxa omnye nje, ekhohlo nasekunene, njenge-parabola.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Oku kukucinga, kulandela imo yamaxabiso etheyibhile ehla emva koko enyuka, ukuba idlula kabini kwicala ngalinye lasekhohlo nasekunene.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Oku kukucinga ukuba, ngenxa yemo echukumisa i-x-axis, iphuzu elinye elongezelelweyo liyongezwa.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Oku kukucinga ukuba, ekubeni akukho x ene-y = 1 kwitheyibhile, azidibani. Cinga ngamaxabiso aphakathi kweenkcukacha zetheyibhile.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngeli xesha, zoba umgca othe tye y = 4, ene-k = 4. Kwitheyibhile, y = 4 xa x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mangaphi amanqaku ahlukileyo abelana ngawo umgca othe tye y = 4 negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukusuka ku-x² − 4 = 4, x = ±2√2 (amachaphaza ama-2), kwaye ukusuka ku-x² − 4 = −4, x = 0 (ichaphaza eli-1), kwaye azidibani, ngoko zi-3 ewonke. k = 4 bubude bencopho yenxalenye egobiweyo ngaphezulu ku-x = 0, ngoko umgca othe tye uchukumisa nje incopho.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba inani liyafana nokuba k iyatshintsha.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okutsiba ukuchukumisa kanye ku-x = 0 kubale amachaphaza amabini angaphandle kuphela.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Oku kukucinga okubala kunye ichaphaza elinye lokuchukumisa ku-x = 0 namachaphaza amabini angaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Oku kukucinga ukuba, kuba k yaba nkulu, iindawo zokunqumla nazo ziyanda.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Ekugqibeleni, zoba umgca othe tye y = 5, ngo-k = 5.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mangaphi amachaphaza ahlukeneyo abelana ngawo umgca othe tye y = 5 negrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukusuka ku-x² − 4 = 5, x = ±3 (amachaphaza ama-2), kwaye x² − 4 = −5 ithetha x² = −1, engenazo iingcambu zokwenyani. Zi-2 ewonke. Xa k iba nkulu kune-4, umgca othe tye unyuka ngaphezulu kwencopho egobiweyo, kwaye amasebe amabini angaphandle kuphela aseleyo.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba okukhona unyusa k, kokukhona kukho iindawo zokunqumla ezininzi.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Oku kukucinga okuthatha inani lexesha ngo-k = 4.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oku kukucinga ukuba, kuba kudlulile kubude bencopho obungu-4, azisadibani. Jonga ukuba likhona x ene-y = 5 kwitheyibhile.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Oku kukucinga ukuba nje ukuba kunyuke ngaphezulu kwencopho egobiweyo, kudibana kuphela neendawo ezimbini zangaphandle.
z-m-40-07.s.s1.reflect: Ngaba ucinge ukuba iindawo zokunqumla ziyanda kuphela xa k inyuswa? Chaza isizathu sokuba, xa k inyuswa isuka kwixabiso elincinci kakhulu, inani leendawo zokunqumla litshintsha njenge-0 → 2 → 4 → 3 → 2, ulidibanise namachaphaza egrafu achukumisa i-eksisi ye-x nencopho egobiweyo.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.prompt: Njengoko k inyuswa kancinci kancinci isuka kwinani elincinci elingalunganga, bhala onke amaxabiso omda e-k apho inani leendawo zokunqumla litshintsha, uze uchaze ukuba umgca othe tye udlula kweyiphi inxalenye yegrafu kumda ngamnye.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kwitheyibhile, fumana elona xabiso lincinci le-y nobude benxalenye egobiweyo kufutshane ne-x = 0.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.hint.1: Seta k ngaphantsi nje nangaphezulu nje komda, uze uthelekise amanani eendawo zokunqumla.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uchaze isizathu sokuba amaxabiso omda e-k ayeloo maxabiso, nokuba bubude beliphi ichaphaza kwigrafu?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Macala onke omda (xa k ingaphantsi komda nalapho inkulu), ngaba uthethe ukuba zingaphi iindawo zokunqumla?
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.0: Imida yi-k=0 kunye ne-k=4. k=0 bubude be-x=±2, apho umgca othe tye uchukumisa i-eksisi ye-x, kwaye xa udlula ngaphezulu koko, kukho iindawo zokunqumla ezi-4. k=4 bubude bencopho egobiweyo ku-x=0, ngoko kukho ezi-3 ngoko, kwaye xa iba nkulu kune-4, ezi-2 kuphela zisala.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.model.1: Xa unyusa umgca othe tye, uqala uchukumisa igrafu ku-k=0 (iindawo zokunqumla ezi-2), phakathi kwe-0 ne-4 kukho ezi-4, ku-k=4 udlula incopho ku-x=0 kwaye kukho ezi-3, kwaye xa k inkulu kune-4 udibana neendawo ezimbini zangaphandle kuphela, ngoko zi-2. Ngoko amaxabiso enza utshintsho yi-0 kunye ne-4.
z-m-40-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Le yimpendulo equka netyala lamachaphaza angu-0 xa k < 0.

z-m-40-04.title: Kuhambo lokuya nokubuya, ukubuya kufuneka kukhawuleze kangakanani ukuze kubekho umndilili wesantya?
z-m-40-04.topic: Umndilili wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya uvezwe ngomsebenzi we-rational: utshintsha njani ngesantya sokubuya, nomda wawo
z-m-40-04.goal: Hlola ngamaxesha ukuba umndilili wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya awungumndilili we-arithmetic wezantya, jonga umda womndilili nokuba isantya sokubuya siphakanyisiwe ngokuqikelela nokubala, uze ufumane izantya ezanelisa imeko wena.
z-m-40-04.material: Ibhasi ihamba uhambo lokuya nokubuya kwindlela efanayo. Xa iya, ihamba ngesantya esingatshintshiyo se-30 km ngeyure, kwaye xa ibuya ihamba ngesantya esingatshintshiyo se-x km ngeyure. Umgama wohambo olunye D km awaziwa, kwaye akukho zimiso endleleni. Umndilili wesantya uchazwa njenge-(umgama opheleleyo ohanjiweyo) ÷ (ixesha elipheleleyo elithathiweyo).
z-m-40-04.thinking.0: Ukuphinda ujonge uqikelelo lokwazi ngolwazi olutsha
z-m-40-04.thinking.1: Ukufunda imilo yotshintsho (inkulu ekuqaleni, emva koko incinci ngokuya ngokuncipha)
z-m-40-04.prereq.0: Inqanaba elabelweyo i-H3 yinqanaba lobunzima kuphela kulo mgaqo wemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibeka oku kwibanga elithile. Ingcinga: sele uyazi isantya = umgama ÷ ixesha nendlela yokubala ngeentetho zeqhezu.
z-m-40-04.prereq.1: Ukubala ngeentetho ze-rational (iqhezu) nemvakalelo yokuba iqhezu liba lincinci njengoko inani elingaphantsi liba likhulu
z-m-40-04.prereq.2: Umgaqo wokuba umndilili wesantya = umgama opheleleyo ÷ ixesha elipheleleyo elithathiweyo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha. Ixesha ngalinye, khetha ukuba umndilili wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya ungaba yintoni.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.0: Misela umgama wohambo olunye kwixabiso elithile elinje nge-60 km, uze ufumane ixesha elithathiweyo ukuya nexesha elithathiweyo ukubuya ngokwahlukeneyo.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kokufumana umgama wohambo lokuya nokubuya nexesha elipheleleyo elithathiweyo, vavanya ukuba isiphumo siyatshintsha na xa utshintsha umgama wohambo olunye kwelinye ixabiso.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Thatha usuku apho isantya sokubuya sasiyi-60 km ngeyure njengomzekelo. Umgama wohambo olunye D awukaziwa.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Umndilili wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya ngalolu suku ungaba yintoni?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba D = 60 km, ukuya kuthatha i-60 ÷ 30 = 2 iiyure kwaye ukubuya kuthatha i-60 ÷ 60 = 1 iyure, ngoko uhambo lokuya nokubuya lwe-120 km lwathatha iiyure ezi-3. Umndilili wesantya yi-120 ÷ 3 = 40 km/h. Isiphumo esifanayo siphuma kwamanye amaxabiso e-D (D iyarhoxiswa). Incinci kune-45 kuba kuchithwe ixesha elingakumbi ngesantya esicothayo.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Le yingcinga ethatha umndilili we-arithmetic wezantya (phakathi kwe-30 ne-60) njengomndilili wesantya.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Le yingcinga ethathela ingqalelo ukuba kuchithwe ixesha elingakumbi ngesantya esicothayo.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Le yingcinga yokuba inxalenye ekhawulezayo inempembelelo enkulu. Thelekisa ixesha elithathiweyo kwinxalenye nganye.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Asiyazi D, ngoko asinakwazi umndilili wesantya nawo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Le yingcinga yokuba unokubala kuphela ukuba umgama uthile. Zama ukumisela D kwi-60 uze uthelekise namanye amaxabiso.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Jonga usuku apho isantya sokubuya siphakanyiswe saya kwi-120 km ngeyure.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Isantya sokubuya siphindwe kabini (60 → 120). Umndilili wesantya utshintsha njani ukusuka kwi-40 km/h?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba D = 120 km, ukuya kuthatha iiyure ezi-4 kwaye ukubuya kuthatha iyure e-1, ngoko isixa yi-240 ÷ 5 = 48 km/h. Nangona isantya siphindwe kabini, umndilili wanda nge-20% kuphela. Oku kungenxa yokuba ixesha elithathiweyo ukuya lihlala lifana, ngoko ixesha lilonke aliwi liye kwisiqingatha.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inyuka ukuya kuphantse kuphindwe kabini, isondele kwi-80 km/h
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba ukuba isantya ekubuyeni siphindwe kabini, umyinge nawo uphindwa kabini ngokulinganayo.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Umyinge wesantya awutshintshi phantse kwaphela kwaye uhlala usondele kwi-40
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Oku kukucinga ukuba utshintsho kwisantya ekubuyeni alubachaphazeli kangako umyinge.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inyuka ukusuka kwi-40 kodwa ayifikeleli ekuphindweni kabini
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Oku kukucinga okucinga ukuba ixesha elithathwa ekuhambeni lihlala lifana.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iba yi-30 km/h, efana nesantya ekuhambeni
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Oku kukucinga ukuba inxalenye ekhawulezayo iyayekelana kumyinge.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Nokuba isantya ekubuyeni siphakanyiswa ukuya kwi-300 yekhilomitha ngeyure, umyinge wesantya ngumalunga ne-54.5 km/h.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukuthatha ukuba isantya ekubuyeni sinokwenziwa sibe sikhulu njengoko ufuna, ingaba kunokwenzeka ukuba umyinge wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya ufikelele kwi-60 yekhilomitha ngeyure?
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Umyinge wesantya yi-60x ÷ (30 + x). Ixesha ekuhambeni sele lisetyenzisiwe, ngoko nokuba ixesha ekubuyeni lenziwa lisondele kwi-0, umyinge usondela kuphela kwi-2D ÷ (D/30) = 60 kwaye awufikeleli kuyo. Ukuba x = 150 yi-50, ukuba yi-300 yimalunga ne-54.5, kwaye ukuba yi-600 yimalunga ne-57.1.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ukuba ugidima ngokukhawuleza ngokwaneleyo ekubuyeni, ekugqibeleni ungafikelela kuyo
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba ukuba unyusa isantya, umyinge nawo unyuka ngaphandle komda.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ukuba isantya ekubuyeni yi-90 yekhilomitha ngeyure, iba ngu-60 kanye
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Oku kukucinga ukuba ihambelana kanye kwisantya esithile. Bala wena umyinge xa isantya sisi-90 yekhilomitha ngeyure.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kufika umzuzu apho ifikelela kwi-60; ayinyanisekanga nje
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oku kukucinga okuphatha ixabiso lomda njengexabiso elinokufikelelwa. Sebenza ukuba ixesha kufuneka lithathe ixesha elingakanani ukuze umyinge ube ngu-60.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Oku kukucinga okucinga ukuba ixesha elithathwa ekuhambeni sele limisiwe.
z-m-40-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni usenokuba ucinge ngomyinge wesantya njengomyinge wezantya (45). Ngowuphi ulwazi (ixesha elithathiweyo) olutshintshe loo ngcinga? Chaza imilo apho umyinge unyuka khona njengoko unyusa isantya ekubuyeni (omkhulu kuqala, wandule ukuncipha) nokuba kutheni umda we-60 uvela.
z-m-40-04.s.s2.prompt: Khetha isantya x ekubuyeni (kwiikhilomitha ngeyure) ukuze umyinge wesantya sohambo lokuya nokubuya usuke kwi-50 yekhilomitha ngeyure ukuya kwi-55 yekhilomitha ngeyure, kwaye ufumane amaxabiso e-x angu-3 ahlukileyo. x linani eliphelele lepositive, kwaye isantya ekuhambeni yi-30 yekhilomitha ngeyure.

z-m-40-05.title: Umsebenzi we-radical onesiphelo (−2, 1): ingaba yifomyula enye kuphela?
z-m-40-05.topic: Umsebenzi we-radical y=√(ax+b)+c: inkululeko esalayo xa ifomyula imiselwa ngolwazi lwesiphelo
z-m-40-05.goal: Gweba ukuba ulwazi malunga nesiphelo esinye simisela amakhonstanti amangaphi omsebenzi we-radical nokuba lushiya amangaphi, yakha iifomyula ezahlukileyo ezanelisa umqathango wena, uze uchaze ukuba yintoni enye efunekayo ukumisela ijika ngokuthe tye.
z-m-40-05.material: Kwiscreen seklasi, igrafu yomsebenzi we-radical y = √(ax + b) + c (funda: 'ingcambu yesikwere ye-a x kongeza b, kongeza c') yavela. Ijika linesiphelo salo sasekhohlo kwi-(−2, 1) kwaye lisuka apho liye kwicala elingaphezulu ekunene. a, b, c ziikhonstanti, kwaye ekubeni lisinda ekunene, a > 0. Akwaziwa ukuba ngawaphi amanye amanqaku adlula kuwo ijika.
z-m-40-05.prereq.0: Inqanaba elabelweyo H3 libubunzima kuphela kulo mthamo wemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibeka olu lwazi kwibanga elithile. Ingcamango: sele uyazi ukuba igrafu yomsebenzi we-radical y = √(ax + b) + c iqala kwisiphelo yandule ukuya kwelinye icala.
z-m-40-05.prereq.1: Amanani anengcambu yesikwere eliyinani eliphelele (izikwere ezigqibeleleyo)
z-m-40-05.prereq.2: Ukubala ukufumana ixabiso le-y ngokufaka x = k kwifomyula
z-m-40-05.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba kunokwenzeka ukuba a, b, c zonke zimiselwe ngokuthe tye ngolwazi lokuba isiphelo yi-(−2, 1) kuphela?
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ixabiso elingaphakathi kwengcambu kufuneka libe yintoni xa ufaka ikhoodinethi ye-x yesiphelo, −2, kwifomyula √(ax + b) + c.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.hint.1: Yakha iifomyula ezimbini ezinesiphelo esifanayo kodwa a ezahlukileyo, uze uthelekise ukuba iigrafu zifana na.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.a: c imisiwe kodwa a iyasala, kwaye b imiselwa yi-a
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.a: Oku kukucinga okuhlolisisa ukuba ulwazi malunga nesiphelo lunxulumana njani nenani lamakhonstanti.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.b: Imisiwe: ukusuka kwikhoodinethi zesiphelo, b = −2, c = 1, kwaye a = 1
z-m-40-05.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okuhambisa ikhoodinethi zesiphelo ngqo kumakhonstanti. Ukuba ufaka x = −2 kwibinzana, ungajonga ukuba isiphelo sithetha ntoni.
z-m-40-05.s.s1.o.c: Ayimiselwanga: a, b, c nganye inokukhethwa ngokukhululekileyo

z-m-40-09.s.s1.hint.1: Jonga ukuba zingaphi ii-x ezinika elona xabiso lincinci le-S, nokuba ezo x zikuluhlu luni.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.o.a: x = 2 okanye x = 6, oko kukuthi, kanye ezilalini kuphela
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.a: Le yingcinga yokuba isitishi kufuneka sakhelwe kanye esilalini ukuze sisondele kakhulu.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.o.b: Kwiindawo ukusuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-5 kuphela
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.b: Le yingcinga yokuba kulungile kuphela kufutshane nommandla ophakathi.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.o.c: Naphi na ukusuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-6
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.c: Le yingcinga yokuba phakathi kwezilali ezimbini isixa semigama asitshintshi.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.r.d: Le yingcinga yokuba ichaphaza elinye eliphakathi kwezilali ezimbini lilona lilungileyo.
z-m-40-09.s.s1.explain: Ukuba x iphakathi kwe-2 ne-6, S(x) = (x − 2) + (6 − x) = 4, engatshintshiyo. Ukuba iphuma ngaphandle, iyanda. Ngoko igrafu ye-S(x) inezantsi elithe tye kwi-2 ≤ x ≤ 6.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.prompt: Isilali C (x = 10) sivelile. Ngoku S₃(x) = |x − 2| + |x − 6| + |x − 10|. Fumana iindawo ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo eziiinteger x zesitishi apho isixa semigama ukuya kwizilali ezintathu singu-10 okanye ngaphantsi. (−5 ≤ x ≤ 15)
z-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.0: Beka ixabiso elinye endaweni ye-x, fumana imigama emithathu ngokwahlukileyo, uze uyidibanise.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tshintsha amaxabiso uze ucutha apho imida ikhona, kwicala apho isixa siba sikhulu kune-10 (ekhohlo nasekunene).
z-m-40-09.s.s2.ok.c1: x yi-integer ukusuka kwi--5 ukuya kwi-15.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.fail.c1: x kufuneka ibe yi-integer ukusuka kwi--5 ukuya kwi-15.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Isixa semigama ukuya kwizilali ezintathu singu-10 okanye ngaphantsi.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Isixa semigama ukuya kwizilali ezintathu sikhulu kune-10. Fumana imigama emithathu ngokwahlukileyo uze uyidibanise kwakhona.
z-m-40-09.s.s2.explain: Obona bubincinci be-S₃(x) bungu-8 kwisilali esiphakathi x = 6, kwaye buyanda njengoko uya kuwo omabini amacala. Amaxabiso angu-10 okanye ngaphantsi yi-4 ≤ x ≤ 8. Ngokungafaniyo netyala lezilali ezimbini, akukho zantsi elithe tye, kwaye indawo yobona bubincinci yindawo enye 6.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ukuba indawo apho isixa semigama sincinci kakhulu ihluka njani phakathi kwezilali ezi-2 (2, 6) nezilali ezi-3 (2, 6, 10), uze ubhale uqikelelo lwakho lokuba kwenzeka ntoni ngezilali ezi-4 (2, 6, 10, 14).
z-m-40-09.s.s3.hint.0: Xa kukho izilali ezi-4, bala i-S₄(x) kwii-x ezininzi kufutshane nommandla ophakathi uze uzithelekise.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuba zazingaphi izilali eziphakathi ngezilali ezi-2 nangezilali ezi-3.
z-m-40-09.s.s3.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ngezilali ezi-2, ..., kwaye ngezilali ezi-3, ..., ngoko ngezilali ezi-4 ...
z-m-40-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale ngamagama akho umahluko phakathi kwenani eliyipheyiri lezilali nenani elingqabangqaba?
z-m-40-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uvavanye uqikelelo lwakho lwezilali ezi-4 ngokubala (umzekelo S₄ kwi-x = 8)?
z-m-40-09.s.s3.model.0: Ngezilali ezi-2, naphi na phakathi kwe-2 ne-6 isixa siyafana, 4, ngoko indawo yobona bubincinci ziindawo ezininzi (isithuba). Ngezilali ezi-3, kuphela kwisilali esiphakathi 6 isixa sincinci kakhulu, 8, ngoko silungiswa sibe yindawo enye. Ngezilali ezi-4, ndicinga ukuba yonke into phakathi kwezilali ezimbini eziphakathi 6 no-10 iya kuba bubona bubincinci (isixa 16).
z-m-40-09.s.s3.model.1: Ngezilali ezi-2 (2, 6) kukho izantsi elithe tye, ngoko naphi na ukusuka kwi-2 ukuya kwi-6 kuyasebenza, kwaye ngezilali ezi-3 (2, 6, 10) isilali esiphakathi 6 sesona bubincinci kuphela. Ngezilali ezi-4 (2, 6, 10, 14), ndiqikelela ukuba lonke uluhlu phakathi kwezilali ezimbini eziphakathi luya kuba bubona bubincinci kwakhona.

z-m-40-10.title: Ukuba amaxabiso etheyibhile ayalingana ekhohlo nasekunene, ingaba igrafu ilingana nayo?
z-m-40-10.topic: Ukulingana kwegrafu yomsebenzi malunga ne-eksisi ye-y: amandla obungqina bokuba izibini ezimbalwa zamaxabiso ziyalingana, nokwakha imizekelo echasayo
z-m-40-10.goal: Ngokusekelwe kwinkcazo yokulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y (f(−x) = f(x) kuzo zonke ii-x), qonda ukuba itheyibhile ebonisa izibini ezimbalwa zamaxabiso ziyalingana ayinakugqiba ukulingana, uze wakhe umzekelo ochasayo wena ukusuka kumsebenzi ohambelana kanye netheyibhile kodwa ongalinganiyo.
z-m-40-10.material: Ifomula yomsebenzi f ayaziwa, kwaye kukho itheyibhile enamaxabiso kwii-x ezimbalwa kuphela. Xa x ingu--2, −1, 0, 1, 2, f(x) yi-4, 1, 0, 1, 4. Amaxabiso kwii-x ezingekho kwitheyibhile ayaziwa. Indawo ngamanani okwenyani onke, kwaye “ukulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y” kuthetha ukuba f(−x) = f(x) iyasebenza kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x. U-Jiho uthe, “Kwitheyibhile amaxabiso kwi-x nakwi-−x ayalingana, ngoko igrafu ye-f ilingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y.”
z-m-40-10.thinking.0: Ukucinga ukuba ubungqina obunesiphelo bufika kude kangakanani
z-m-40-10.prereq.0: Inqanaba elabelwe i-H3 linqanaba lobunzima kolu lwabiwo lwemveliso kuphela, kwaye alithethi ukuba ikharityhulam ibeka oku kwibanga elithile. Ingcamango: sele uyayazi intsingiselo yokulingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y (ukuba ichaphaza (x, y) likhona, ngoko (−x, y) likhona nalo) nendlela yokubala amaxabiso e-polynomial.
z-m-40-10.prereq.2: Ingqiqo yokuba ukutshintsha x ngo--x kutshintsha uphawu lwamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba
z-m-40-10.s.s1.hint.0: Wahlula ii-x ezikwitheyibhile kwezo ezingekho, uze ujonge ukuba f(−x) no-f(x) zinokuthelekiswa nganye.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ibinzana elithi “kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x” lifika kude kangakanani kwitheyibhile.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.a: Kwi-x = ±1, ±2, f(−x) = f(x), kwaye asiyazi eseleyo
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.a: Oku kukucinga okwahlula izibini ezijongiweyo kumaxabiso angajongwanga.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.b: Zombini izibini ezijongiweyo kwitheyibhile zilungile, ngoko kuqinisekisiwe ukuba igrafu ilingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.b: Oku kukucinga okwandisa izibini ezimbalwa ezijongiweyo kuzo zonke ii-x. “Kuzo zonke ii-x” kuquka ii-x ezingekho kwitheyibhile.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.c: Zikho izibini ezimbini kuphela, ngoko akukho nto inokuthethwa ngale theyibhile
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.c: Oku kukucinga okulahla nenyani yokuba iyasebenza kwizibini ezimbini ezijongiweyo. Phinda ufunde ukuba itheyibhile ibonisa ntoni ngokwenene.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.o.d: Zombini izibini zazilungile, ngoko kunokwenzeka ukuba ilingana kwaye phantse ingqinisisiwe
z-m-40-10.s.s1.r.d: Oku kukucinga okuthatha inani elikhulayo lezibini ezijongiweyo njengobungqina. Ukujonga okunesiphelo akunakucima umzekelo ochasayo.
z-m-40-10.s.s1.explain: Itheyibhile ibonisa ukuba f(−x) = f(x) kuphela ku-x = ±1, ±2. Kwii-x ezingekho kwitheyibhile akwaziwa, ngoko asinakuqinisekisa ukuba ilingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.prompt: Ngoluphi uhlobo lweziseko ezifunekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba igrafu ilingana malunga ne-eksisi ye-y?
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa ukuba x enye ianela na ukuba ngumzekelo ochasayo obonisa ukuba ayilingani, nokuba zingaphi ii-x ezanelayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ilingana.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa inani leziseko ezifunekayo xa ungqina “kuwo onke” nalapho uphikisa.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.a: Ukuba sibhala namaxabiso kwi-x = ±3, ±4, ±5 kwitheyibhile kwaye onke ayafana, ukulingana kuqinisekisiwe
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.a: Oku kukucinga ukuba ukuba wongeza amachaphaza amaninzi, okupheleleyo kuqinisekisiwe. Nokuba ujonga inani elinesiphelo elongezelelweyo, umzekelo ochasayo unokuhlala ngaphandle kwetheyibhile.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.b: Ukuba ucwangcisa amachaphaza amaninzi uwadibanise, athatha isimo esibonakala silingana ngokubanzi ekhohlo nasekunene
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.b: Oku kukucinga okusebenzisa impembelelo ebonwa liso njengesiseko. Amaxabiso ahluke kancinci awabonakali emfanekisweni.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.c: Xa ifomula inikiwe, bala f(−x) ubonise ukuba yintetho efanayo ne-f(x)
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.c: Oku kukucinga okubonisa ukuba iyasebenza kunobumba x, kuphatha “zonke ii-x” ngaxeshanye.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.o.d: Ukuba umlinganiselo wezibini kwitheyibhile ezihambelanayo uyisiqingatha okanye ngaphezulu, ukulingana kuqinisekisiwe
z-m-40-10.s.s2.r.d: Oku kukucinga okugweba “kuzo zonke ii-x” ngomgangatho womlinganiselo. Ukuba enye nje ayisebenzi, ayilingani.
z-m-40-10.s.s2.explain: Ukuqinisekisa “f(−x) = f(x) kuzo zonke ii-x,” kufuneka ubonise ngefomula kunobumba x okanye uphathe zonke ii-x ngenye indlela. Ukujonga amachaphaza amaninzi kwitheyibhile kunokunyusa ukholo, kodwa akuqinisekisi.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.prompt: Imisebenzi g(x) = x² + c·x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) (c yi-constant) yanelisa amaxabiso etheyibhile kanye kwi-x = 0, ±1, ±2 (0; 1, 1; 4, 4) (jonga ngokubeka amaxabiso wena). Yakha ubungqina bokuba ezinye zale misebenzi azilingani: khetha i-integer engeyo-0 c (−3 ≤ c ≤ 3) kunye nenani eliqinisekileyo t ukuze g(t) ≠ g(−t), uze ufumane (c, t) ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.0: Misa c e-1 no-t e-1, bala g(t) no-g(−t) ngokwahlukeneyo, uze uthelekise.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa oko kwenzekayo xa ufaka t njengexabiso elikwitheyibhile (1, 2) nanjengexabiso elingekho kwitheyibhile (njenge-3).
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c1: c linani eliphelele elingelilo u-zero elisuka ku-−3 ukuya ku-3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c1: c kufuneka ibe linani eliphelele elingelilo u-zero elisuka ku-−3 ukuya ku-3.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.ok.c3: g(t) no-g(−t) ziyahluka. Obu bungqina bokuba ayilingani malunga ne-y-axis.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Kule t, g(t) no-g(−t) zifanayo. Lixabiso elikwitheyibhile okanye ixabiso apho ziphuma zilingana. Vavanya enye t.
z-m-40-10.s.s3.explain: x(x² − 1)(x² − 4) ingu-0 kwi-x = 0, ±1, ±2, ngoko amaxabiso etheyibhile ahlala efana, kodwa xa x ithathelwa indawo ngu-−x, uphawu luba chasene. Ngoko ukuba t ayiyi-1 okanye 2, g(t) no-g(−t) zahluke ngamaxesha ama-2 e-c·t(t² − 1)(t² − 4). Lo ngumzekelo ochasayo obonisa ukuba amaxabiso amahlanu etheyibhile odwa awakwazi ukuqinisekisa ukulingana.
